text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

text.tspan: # session 1: the planner desk writes the plan; its session ends and a receipt is sealed
# hand-off 1: the gate 'planned' wants the plan and a receipt
$ desk deliver slug engineer plan --evidence PLAN.md
# someone edits the receipt after it was signed
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/edited.json
check refused engineer:receipt on slug (exit 1): ./verify-receipt {evidence} planner@office
INVALID receipts/edited.json: signature does not match its bytes
# a key the office does not trust signs a receipt of its own
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/stranger-80df.json
check refused engineer:receipt on slug (exit 1): ./verify-receipt {evidence} planner@office
REFUSED receipts/stranger-80df.json: signed by a key this office does not trust
# a desk the office trusts, but the wrong one for this gate
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/builder-71a0.json
check refused engineer:receipt on slug (exit 1): ./verify-receipt {evidence} planner@office
REFUSED receipts/builder-71a0.json: signed by builder@office, this gate takes planner@office
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/planner-d608.json
$ desk deliver slug owner go --note "plan reads right"
# session 2: the builder desk, a separate session, builds what the plan says
# hand-off 2: can the planner's receipt be reused for this gate?
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/planner-d608.json
that evidence was already accepted at slug planned:engineer:receipt; one file backs one link
# the office runs the tests itself, then takes the builder's receipt
$ desk deliver slug engineer tests-green --evidence "python3 -m unittest"
$ desk deliver slug engineer receipt --evidence receipts/builder-b239.json
$ desk deliver slug owner accept --note shipped
# anyone with the repo can re-check every link
# one byte changes in an accepted receipt
evidence changed since it was accepted
every hand-off came out as expected: 4 links accepted, 5 bad hand-offs refused, 1 tampered link caught
